name: Srestha Finvest Limited
summary: Srestha Finvest Limited, a non-banking finance company, provides loans, finance, and investment services in India. It operates through two segments, Financing and Investment Activities. The company provides credit solutions to corporate and personal private clients for initial funding requirements of a project, mezzanine financing, acquisition financing, project financing, bridge financing, promoter funding, short term and long term working capital requirements, personal finance, etc. It also invests and trades in stocks and shares. The company was formerly known as M.S. Investments Limited. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Chennai, India.
